changelog: Spoken punctuation now understands curly braces: say "open curly brace" / "close curly brace" (or "open brace" / "close brace") and a set or grouped expression dictates itself ("set open curly brace name close curly brace" becomes "set {name}"). In Bengali, say "দ্বিতীয় বন্ধনী শুরু" / "দ্বিতীয় বন্ধনী শেষ" — the missing second bracket, completing প্রথম / দ্বিতীয় / তৃতীয় বন্ধনী. Also fixes the Settings hint, which now lists the square brackets too, and a wrong Bengali parenthesis example in the help text. Works in the app and in the voice keyboard, only when the spoken-punctuation setting is on.
